output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
# Loading  data
FRB_DSR <- read.csv("C:/Users/jeant/Downloads/FRB_DSR.csv") 

library(fpp2)

str(FRB_DSR)

##

attributes(FRB_DSR)

plot(FRB_DSR)
##
myTimeSeries <- ts(FRB_DSR$DSR_RATIO)
plot(myTimeSeries)

##
Acf(myTimeSeries)

## take Mean of all available observation
mean_forecast <- meanf(myTimeSeries, 5)
plot(mean_forecast)

## Naive
naive_forecast <- naive(myTimeSeries)
plot(naive_forecast)

##
snaive_forecast <- snaive(myTimeSeries)
plot(snaive_forecast)

## Random walk
rwf_forecast <- rwf(myTimeSeries,5)
rwf_forecast <- rwf(myTimeSeries,5, drift = TRUE)

## Moving averages
MA5_forecast <- ma(myTimeSeries,order = 5)
MA9_forecast <- ma(myTimeSeries,order = 9)

## Plot all in a single chart
plot(mean_forecast)
lines(naive_forecast$mean, col="red")
lines(rwf_forecast$mean,col="green")
lines(snaive_forecast$mean, col="black")
lines(MA5_forecast, col="Pink")
lines(MA9_forecast,col="Blue")

## What other attributes are there
attributes(naive_forecast)

## Decomposition
ets_forecast <- ets(myTimeSeries)
plot(ets_forecast)

## 
attributes(ets_forecast)

##
ets_forecast$amse

## HoltWinters

## 
SSE_Simple <- HoltWinters(myTimeSeries,beta = FALSE,gamma = FALSE)
attributes(SSE_Simple)

## 
plot(SSE_Simple)

##
SSE_Simple$SSE

##
head(SSE_Simple$fitted)

## Forecast
forecast_ets_1 <- forecast.ets(ets_forecast, h=5)
plot(forecast_ets_1)

##
forecast_ets_2 <- forecast(ets_forecast, h=5)
plot(forecast_ets_2)


```
